snippet.title: Beyond These Stars - Gameplay Trailer | City-Builder On A Space Whale
snippet.description:
Build a fragile economy, travel the galaxy, and discover what lies beyond in this new gameplay trailer! In Beyond These Stars, you will build a city on the back of Kewa, a massive space whale, balancing city expansion with the welfare of this gentle giant. 

Beyond These Stars is set to release into Early Access in 2026
